title: Fixture event A
summary: Synthetic record used by the test suite. It is not history and describes nothing that happened.
body: ## What the fixture is for This body exercises the entry renderer end to end. It is synthetic and describes nothing that happened, like every other fixture record. It names a place ([Fixture place A](place:fixture-place-a)), an actor ([Fixture Actor One](actor:fixture-actor-one)) and another event ([Fixture event B](event:fixture-event-b)), and it cites the one source this record rests on[^fixture-source-1 p. 12]. ### The constructs - *emphasis* and **strong emphasis** - a list item that cites the same work again[^fixture-source-1] - a link out to the web: [an example](https://example.org/fixture) > A block quotation, which is one of the constructs the subset allows. Raw HTML such as this is shown as the characters that were typed, and never as markup.
